changes.comment: Inbound messages reach the model as one `` body. A mention is written `Name`, the same syntax the `reply` tool takes, for every message type and only where the platform's mention records name one; a record without a user identity reads as `@Name`. A card is read from the event alone, contributes its text and its images and files, and gets a `` row saying it is a rich card the model can pull in full with lark-cli; the two card reads and their merge are gone. Images and files anywhere in a message are downloaded, cached, and budgeted as before and rendered as `` where they stood. Code blocks are fenced Markdown instead of ``. `FeishuInboundEvent` carries `text` and `resources` instead of `parsedText` and `contentParts`; `FEISHU_SKILL_FALLBACK_NOTE` is removed.
